title: Defense Against Algorithm-Substitution Attacks in Big-Key Encryption
summary: The model assumes trusted encryption code, while whether big-key symmetric encryption admits any defense against algorithm-substitution attacks with untrusted code remains open.

formal_statement.body: The big-key symmetric-encryption model assumes trusted encryption code. Determine whether any defense against algorithm-substitution attacks is possible for big-key symmetric encryption when the encryption code is untrusted.

scope.domain: The domain is big-key symmetric encryption under algorithm-substitution attacks.
assumptions: The baseline model assumes trusted encryption code.
The unresolved case considers untrusted encryption code.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether any defense against algorithm-substitution attacks is possible for big-key symmetric encryption when the encryption code is untrusted.

citations.label: Big-Key Symmetric Encryption: Resisting Key Exfiltration

progress.summary: The paper states that its model trusts the encryption code, then identifies algorithm-substitution attacks as the untrusted-code setting. It explicitly leaves open whether any defense is possible in the big-key setting.
citation_labels: Mihir Bellare et al., Big-Key Symmetric Encryption: Resisting Key Exfiltration
